Title: Technical Customer Support Specialist
Company: Acorn Cloud Software
Location: Remote - US
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: $55,000 annually

Acorn Cloud Software builds workflow software for operations teams.

Responsibilities
- Troubleshoot customer issues across the web app and API.
- Reproduce bugs, document findings, and escalate engineering issues with clear notes.
- Support customers over email and chat.
- Maintain help center documentation.

Requirements
- Strong debugging and communication skills.
- Familiarity with APIs, logs, HTML, or JavaScript is helpful.
